plugins.name: Clean links
plugins.author: murk-sus
plugins.description: Removes tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid, gclid, si, igsh…) from links you send, so they do not reveal where you found them.

plugins.name: Layout fix
plugins.author: murk-sus
plugins.description: Fixes text typed in the wrong keyboard layout: "ghbdtn" → "привет", "руддщ" → "hello". Only whole messages that clearly look mistyped are changed.

plugins.name: Minimal UI
plugins.author: murk-sus
plugins.description: A calmer Telegram: hides stories, similar channels, Premium statuses, the greeting sticker and the fast-share button while enabled. Turning the plugin off brings everything back.

plugins.name: Smart quotes
plugins.author: murk-sus
plugins.description: Straight quotes become «ёлочки» in Russian text and “curly” quotes otherwise; "--" becomes an em dash.

plugins.name: Text shortcuts
plugins.author: murk-sus
plugins.description: Expands shortcuts in outgoing messages: :shrug: → ¯\_(ツ)_/¯, :lenny: → ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°), :tableflip: → (╯°□°)╯︵ ┻━┻, ->, <-, (c), (tm) and more.
